steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ directly on the buyer’s Overview screen.
Verify the initial participation count is zero of two invited vendors.
Verify the initial participation percentage is zero.
Switch to Vendor A’s supplier portal session.
Open the prepared RFQ’s pricing round for Vendor A.
Submit Vendor A’s bid so the participation count should increase.
Return to the buyer’s Overview page without explicitly reloading it.
Verify the buyer now sees one of two vendors participating.
Verify the buyer’s participation percentage updated to 50%.
